speaker: AXIOM-7
text: AXIOM-7: Ascent telemetry locked. Freight lift rising from sub-level six. All seventeen liberated captives secured on platform.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: OCEANUS: Their vital signs are stabilizing. The stasis fluid in their lungs is clearing... breathe slowly, you're safe now. No one will ever cage you again.

speaker: AURA
text: AURA: The scream in the network... it's fading. For miles beneath the concrete, the forced resonance has broken. Their minds belong to them again.

speaker: TITAN
text: TITAN: Reactor pressure is venting safely into the geothermal sinks. The containment walls held. The foundation beneath Downtown Core won't collapse.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: MIRAGE: Take a look at the data disk I pulled from the vault terminal. This wasn't an isolated rogue lab. Every pod order was authorized directly from the Citadel Spire.

speaker: SURYA
text: SURYA // COMMS: Kaito! Extraction corridor is clear topside. Emergency medics and underground transit convoys are standing by at the maintenance junction.

speaker: SURYA
text: SURYA // COMMS: Warning: Citadel high command has detected the breach. Heavy orbital defense arrays are rotating to lock down the upper sectors.

speaker: KAITO
text: KAITO: They turned our people into machine components and buried them in the dark. But the Cyber-Grave is empty today. Every captive returns with us.

speaker: KAITO
text: KAITO: Tend to the wounded. Rest for one hour. When we reach the surface, we take the fight straight to the Citadel Spire. Axiom Force—ascend!
